_comentario: Datos de origen para tools/gen_palabras.py --libro firstwords («First Words», ver notes/06-first-words.md). Este fichero SÍ se edita a mano; content/firstwords/generated-*.tex NO. Trimestre 4 (verano), días 196-260: una frase al día, de dos palabras (semanas 40-43) a tres (44-47) y cuatro (48-52). Son decodable text: cada palabra se lee sonido a sonido con todo lo aprendido, o es una tricky word de los viernes de primavera, o un nombre del reparto.

actividad.prompt: Amy is packing her suitcase for London: T-shirts, shorts, a raincoat, her paints and a photo of Pip. Draw her suitcase.
the taxi taking the Browns away, and Amy waving goodbye.
Dani's little green suitcase, with an orange dinosaur on it.

actividad.adivinanza: I have got pages with stories and pictures inside me. Lucía takes two of me to the village, in English. What am I?

actividad.prompt: Draw the suitcase that you would take on holiday.
The family arrives at Grandma's house in the village. In the patio, there is a lemon tree and a hen house. Draw Grandma waiting at the door.
Bigotes is Andrés' cat: white and orange, with very long whiskers. Turn the wavy lines into his whiskers, and draw the rest of him.
Toby sleeping under the table, in the shade.

actividad.instruccion: Match each animal to its sound.
actividad.prompt: Grandma's five hens in the patio.
Draw dinner in the patio, under the lemon tree, when the stars come out.
A postcard from Amy! On the front, there is a tall clock tower and a red bus with two floors. “It rains every day!” she says. Draw the postcard.
Dani colouring a London bus, like the one on Amy's postcard.
Dad cooking a paella in the patio, and Toby watching him.

actividad.adivinanza: I am small, I have got a picture on me, and you stick me on a letter. Lucía's has got a lemon on it! What am I?

actividad.prompt: Draw a postcard from a place that you love.
A picnic by the river! Grandma puts a big blanket under a tree, with a basket of sandwiches and peaches. Draw it.
Turn the oval into the big rock in the middle of the river, where Lucía sits in the sun.
Dani looking at five little fish, swimming between the stones.

actividad.instruccion: Match each word to its opposite.
actividad.prompt: Grandma telling a very old riddle by the river.
Draw the little boat made of wood and a leaf, floating down the river.
Andrés shows the children his beehives. He puts on a white suit, yellow gloves and a hat with a net. Draw him!
a bee on a flower. If a bee lands on you, stay very still!
the bees buzzing round the flowers.

actividad.adivinanza: I am black and yellow, I fly from flower to flower, and I make honey. What am I?

actividad.prompt: Draw Dani standing like a statue, with a bee on his arm.
Grandma shows them seven stars that look like a saucepan: four make the pan, and three make the handle. Draw them.
A shooting star is a tiny bit of dust that burns in the sky. Turn the zigzag into a shooting star, flying past the moon.
the whole village on blankets in the grass, looking at the stars.
your wish on a shooting star -- but don't say it out loud!
Draw the night sky, full of stars.
The sky goes dark. Three big black clouds come over the hill, and the wind starts to blow. Draw the storm.
Grandma lighting two candles, and everybody round the table.
the patio after the storm: a big branch on the table, and three lemons under it.

actividad.adivinanza: I am yellow, I grow on a tree in Grandma's patio, and you can make a drink with me. What am I?

actividad.prompt: Draw the letter from Amy: the Browns are coming to the village!
actividad.banner: 230 pages read! After the storm, the sun!

actividad.prompt: It is festival week! Red and yellow flags go from the town hall to the church tower. Draw the village square.
Turn the square into the festival poster on the door of the town hall. What does it say?
Dani eating six churros with sugar!

actividad.instruccion: Match each animal to its home.
actividad.prompt: Lucía, Dani and Martín reading their riddle on the stage.
Draw the fireworks over the village at midnight.
Amy sits on the bridge with her sketchbook and draws what she can see: the church, the old mill and the river. Draw it with her.
Sam holding one of Grandma's hens, very carefully.
Amy's ice cream with three scoops: pink, brown and yellow.

actividad.adivinanza: I am green, I jump, I live near the river, and I say “croak”. What am I?

actividad.prompt: Draw dinner in Grandma's patio with the two families, and Mr Brown's scones.
Lucía and Amy plan a treasure hunt for Dani, Sam and Martín. Draw their map of the patio, with an X for the treasure!
Turn the oval into the stone where the X is. The first clue is under it!
the second clue, tied to a branch of the lemon tree.

actividad.instruccion: Match each animal to its baby.
actividad.prompt: the box full of treasure under the table: swimming goggles and sweets!
Draw your own treasure map, with an X where the treasure is.
Andrés gives Lucía a jar of honey. On the label, there is a bee with a magnifying glass! Draw the jar.
the car going back to the city, with Toby in the middle.
Pip's cage on the round table again, next door.

actividad.adivinanza: I am full of words, somebody writes me, and I go inside an envelope. Martín sends one to Dani, with a secret message! What am I?

actividad.prompt: Draw a comic of your summer, in three pictures.
Dani is going to start at the big school! Mum buys him a red rucksack with a green T. rex on the front. Draw it.
Lucía writes some reading tips for Dani. Turn the square into her page of tips.
the stationery shop: a blue notebook, purple pencils, and a pen for Sam.

actividad.instruccion: Match each word to its opposite.
actividad.prompt: Sam in his English school uniform, with his crooked tie!
Draw your school bag, ready for the first day.
School starts again! Paco says hello to everyone at the gate, and Dani and Sam are in Marta's class. Draw them at the gate.
Dani and Sam at the same table, drawing their summer.
Lucía and Amy's new classroom, with a map of the world on the board.

actividad.adivinanza: I have got four seasons: autumn, winter, spring and summer. You read one page of this book for every day of me! What am I?

actividad.prompt: Draw everything that you have learnt to read this year.
